descriptions.w3d_r24a_copy_retain_800ccd04: Copies the interface pointer from source +40 to holder +0, invokes observed virtual retain slot +12 when nonnull, and returns the holder.
descriptions.w3d_r24a_damp_value_800dbd74: Updates float velocity +140 using fused negative position +136 times external stiffness plus old velocity, multiplies by external damping, adds velocity to position, and leaves the new position in f1.
descriptions.w3d_r24a_append_empty_entry_8016e908: Indexes a 20-byte record at queue +388 using count +548, clears its first four words while preserving its fifth, increments count, and returns the record.
descriptions.w3d_r24a_check_container_userdata_8019e6: Checks Lua type 7, compares the value metatable with environment index -10002, reports external ctr type error on mismatch, pops the metatable and returns userdata.
